lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.submit_report_with_deduplication(p_description text, p_location text, p_latitude double precision, p_longitude double precision, p_category text, p_priority text, p_summary text, p_recommendation text, p_radius_meters double precision)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/submit_report_with_deduplication`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
